reserves.name: apyUSD deployed strategy positions
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Apyx apyUSD vault and its apxUSD strategy accounting

sources.label: Apyx product documentation and deployment registry
Ethereum apyUSD verified proxy and current token holdings

reserveReview.rationale: Apyx identifies apyUSD as the yield-bearing wrapper minted by staking apxUSD and publishes the Ethereum apyUSD and apxUSD contracts. The live ERC-4626 adapter reports the direct apxUSD balance separately from the small totalAssets-to-balance difference. That difference is classified conservatively as an Apyx vault protocol position rather than assigned to an undisclosed venue.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Live ERC-4626 totalAssets and apxUSD balance for the published Ethereum apyUSD deployment
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The deployed-position venue is not published. Its Apyx vault failure domain and apxUSD strategy-accounting identity are established without assigning a venue.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: The adapter-derived deployed amount is a vault accounting position, not a separately identified tracked stablecoin balance.
